title: Breckenridge History Museum

services.name: Hike the Golden Horseshoe
services.desc: Get ready for an exhilarating 2.5-mile journey through Colorado’s Golden Horseshoe, a region pulsing with rich mining history and breathtaking mountain landscapes. Discover the fascinating story of early mining operations as you explore the remarkable remains of the historic Reiling dredge boat, with your knowledgeable guide bringing the area’s pioneering spirit to life. Breckenridge Ski Resort and the stunning Ten Mile Range provide a spectacular backdrop, offering endless opportunities for memorable photographs and panoramic views.
